g.text: build SGL for target RDMA READ
Both IPUs do fabric offload only — no NVMe logic.
Pull model: initiator sends NVMe-oF WRITE command capsule;
target Xeon (nvmet-rdma) posts an RDMA READ against the
initiator's pre-registered TX MR. The CPU gates when to post
based on free target DRAM buffers, SSD utilization, and QoS;
the RDMA engine then executes the transfer. Buffers return to
the free pool after the SSD write completes.
